status: prospective suitability amendment before any v3 experimental output

amends.rule: all base fields remain binding unless explicitly superseded here

historical_versions.v3.1.0: pre-execution suitability amendment before any model or image output

execution_boundary.additional_blocker: two independent human annotators must be named and confirmed before capability-image creation

candidate_shortlist.selection_basis: primary papers and official artifact suitability before output only
candidate_shortlist.pipeline_a_rule: preserved without model shopping; pair-crop action and interaction classification is an experimental compositional hypothesis whose failure is valid
candidate_shortlist.pipeline_b_change: EGTR replaces SGTR prospectively for clearer released artifacts, one-GPU evaluation, newer graph-native design, and bounded tensor outputs

compute.full_inference_machine: any documented dedicated research GPU; installed device capacity is not a gate and no secret-bearing cloud service is allowed
compute.hardware_selection_timing: before validation output and independent of semantic accuracy outcomes

measurement_protocol.scope: complete pipeline including model components, adapters, and compiler for one image
measurement_protocol.gate_value: maximum measured allocated VRAM across development, validation, and repeat runs

opportunity_definition.positive: one predeclared visible reference atom in its image/entity/pair/category/scene scope
opportunity_definition.applicable_negative: one predeclared false closed-label alternative in the same scope; unqueried absent vocabulary labels do not count

dataset_support.insufficient_support_effect: neither pass nor failure of unrelated types; type cannot enter L_cred
dataset_support.support_freeze_timing: family assignments and opportunity counts fixed before image creation; no expansion after any model output
dataset_support.development_layout: mirror validation opportunity layout for development-only threshold fitting; development observations never contribute validation support
dataset_support.naturalistic_density_bound: two to four visible entities per image; two entity positives and at most four additional primary facts may share those entities

annotation.reason: two independent project researchers are not evidenced as guaranteed
annotation.replacement_protocol: one project researcher plus one qualified independent external human annotator
annotation.adjudication: documented human consensus against the frozen visibility rubric before inference; retain raw annotations and report agreement

gate_v3_a1.compiler_invariants: unchanged v3.0 requirement: all 320 or more cases pass exactly
gate_v3_a1.resource_limits: measured consumption limits in compute; installed GPU capacity excluded
gate_v3_a1.pass_rule: at least one complete frozen pipeline passes all compiler, operational, repeatability, measured-resource, support, per-type, per-stratum, and language checks
